feeds.title: Institute for Health Transformation News
feeds.description: Institute for Health Transformation features articles on information, news and more on Health Economics in the following section. The Institute for Health Transformation at Deakin University aims to activate healthy populations and communities, innovate health service delivery and design, empower consumers as advocates for health system change, and drive equity and value in health and care.

feeds.title: Australian Health Economics Society
feeds.description: The Australian Health Economics Society promotes the study, practice and development of health economics in Australia and health economics analysis in informing policy and health practice in Australia and internationally.
